dataset: Walsh, J. E., Chapman, W. L., Fetterer, F. & Stewart, J. S. (2019). Gridded Monthly Sea Ice Extent and Concentration, 1850 Onward, Version 2. NSIDC.
method: Mid-September fields for 1850, 1920, 1957, 1968 and 1978. Extent sums the published cell areas where concentration is at least 15%. Gap-fill percentage sums the areas of ice extent cells with source flag 17 or 18, divided by total extent. Display contours trace ice extent cells, project to EPSG:3411 and simplify at a 4.5 km tolerance.
